title: Valid activation link successfully activates account
gherkin:
Feature: Activation Link Security
  Scenario: Valid activation link successfully activates account
    Given a user has registered with a valid email address
    When the user clicks the activation link in the email
    And the activation token is valid and not expired
    Then the system shall update the account status from Pending to Active
    And the user shall be able to authenticate to the platform
rationale: Verifies the core activation flow: a valid, non-expired activation link successfully transitions an account from Pending to Active status, enabling platform access.
usedContextItems: System shall update account status from Pending to Active upon successful activation|System shall verify the validity of the activation link before account activation

Hi All,

During the latest compliance review, Legal raised a blocking concern regarding how consent is collected in the registration journey.

At the moment, the current approach appears to bundle multiple legal acknowledgements too closely. For launch readiness, users need to express consent to the contractual terms and the personal-data-related notice in a clearly distinguishable way. A single combined acknowledgement is not sufficient for this purpose.

Please adjust the registration flow so that these approvals are captured independently and can be demonstrated separately if needed during audit.

This is a release-blocking compliance item.

Best regards,

Dr. Arpad Jog
General Counsel

Subject: Question about promotional content in reminder communications

Hi Team,

For the beta period, Marketing would like to explore whether reminder-style emails could also carry a small promotional or onboarding message, instead of treating product messaging and operational reminders as completely separate streams.

Before we move in that direction, we need guidance on how this should interact with user notification settings. From a campaign perspective, the reminder channel looks attractive because it already reaches active users at important points in the rental journey. However, we do not want to assume that a message containing both operational and promotional content should automatically follow the same preference rules as a purely operational reminder.

Please advise whether this needs a dedicated notification category, a separate consent decision, or a strict separation between transactional and promotional messaging.

Best,
Marketing Dept.

title: Expired activation token is rejected
gherkin:
Feature: Activation Link Security
  Scenario: Expired activation token is rejected
    Given a user has registered and received an activation link
    When the activation token has exceeded its time limit
    And the user attempts to use the expired activation link
    Then the system shall reject the activation request
    And the account status shall remain Pending
    And the user shall not be able to authenticate to the platform
rationale: Ensures that time-limited activation tokens are enforced, preventing unauthorized account activation after the token validity window has closed.

title: Multiple activation attempts with same token succeed only once
gherkin:
Feature: Activation Link Security
  Scenario: Multiple activation attempts with same token succeed only once
    Given a user has activated their account using a valid activation token
    When the same activation token is reused in a subsequent activation attempt
    Then the system shall reject the second activation request
    And the account status shall remain Active
    And the token shall be invalidated after first use
rationale: Prevents token reuse attacks by ensuring that activation tokens can only be used once, invalidating them after successful activation.

Marketing Dept.

Feature: Activation Link Security

    Given a user has registered and received an activation token
    When the activation token is within its validity window
    Then the token shall be accepted for activation
    When the activation token exceeds its validity window
    Then the token shall be rejected
    And the account shall remain Pending
rationale: Validates that activation tokens have a defined time-limited validity window, and tokens outside this window are consistently rejected.

title: Unique activation links prevent account enumeration
gherkin:
Feature: Activation Link Security
  Scenario: Unique activation links prevent account enumeration
    Given multiple users have registered
    When activation links are generated for each user
    Then each activation link shall be unique
    And activation links from different users shall not be interchangeable
    And using one user's activation link shall not activate another user's account
rationale: Ensures that each activation link is unique to a specific account, preventing attackers from using one user's link to activate another account and mitigating account enumeration risks.
